subject: Chemistry
title: d- and f-Block Elements
summary: Transition (d-block) elements ke atom ya common ion mein d orbitals adhoore bhare hote hain: configuration (n − 1)d¹⁻¹⁰ ns¹⁻². Zn, Cd aur Hg (har state mein d¹⁰) asli transition elements nahi gine jaate.

Typical properties: high melting points (d electrons se strong metallic bonding), variable oxidation states, rangeen ions (d–d transitions), paramagnetism (magnetic, unpaired electrons), catalyst activity, complex banana, interstitial compounds aur alloy.
KMnO₄ aur K₂Cr₂O₇ do key compounds hain: strong oxidising agents jinki preparation, structure aur reactions baar-baar poochhe jaate hain.

Lanthanoid (4f) zyadatar +3 dikhate hain; lanthanoid contraction ki wajah se group ke 4d aur 5d elements (Zr–Hf) lagbhag same size ke. Actinoid (5f) radioactive hain aur zyada oxidation states dikhate hain.

formulas.name: General configuration
formulas.mistake: Cr = [Ar]3d⁵4s¹ aur Cu = [Ar]3d¹⁰4s¹ (half/fully filled d ki extra stability) — 4s² mat likho.

formulas.name: Spin-only magnetic moment
formulas.mistake: ION ke unpaired d electrons gino, pehle 4s electrons hataakar — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: Oxidation states
formulas.formula: maximum = (n − 1)d + ns electrons up to Mn (+7);  Sc only +3;  Zn only +2;  common for many: +2 and +3

formulas.name: Colour
formulas.formula: arises from d–d transitions; d⁰ (Sc³⁺, Ti⁴⁺) and d¹⁰ (Zn²⁺, Cu⁺) ions are colourless

formulas.name: E° and stability
formulas.formula: E°(M²⁺/M) mostly negative;  Cu has positive E° (+0.34 V) — doesn't liberate H₂ from acids;  Mn²⁺ (d⁵) and Zn²⁺ (d¹⁰) are especially stable

formulas.name: KMnO₄ in acid
formulas.mistake: Neutral/weakly alkaline medium mein MnO₄⁻ → MnO₂ (3e⁻); strongly alkaline mein → MnO₄²⁻ (1e⁻) — medium check karo.

formulas.name: Chromate–dichromate equilibrium
formulas.mistake: Cr +6 hi rehta hai — ye acid–base change hai, redox nahi, confuse mat karo.

formulas.name: Preparation of KMnO₄
formulas.formula: MnO₂ fused with KOH + O₂ → K₂MnO₄ (green manganate) → disproportionation/electrolytic oxidation → KMnO₄ (purple)

formulas.name: Preparation of K₂Cr₂O₇
formulas.formula: chromite ore FeCr₂O₄ + Na₂CO₃ + O₂ → Na₂CrO₄ → (H⁺) Na₂Cr₂O₇ → (KCl) K₂Cr₂O₇

formulas.name: Lanthanoid contraction
formulas.formula: steady decrease in size from La to Lu due to poor shielding by 4f electrons
formulas.when: Zr aur Hf ke radii lagbhag barabar aur chemistry milti-julti kyun.
formulas.note: Ln(OH)₃ ki basicity La(OH)₃ se Lu(OH)₃ tak ghatti hai.

formulas.name: Lanthanoid oxidation states
formulas.formula: +3 common;  Ce⁴⁺ strong oxidant (→ Ce³⁺);  Eu²⁺, Yb²⁺ reductants (→ +3)

examples.title: KMnO₄ reduction mein electrons
examples.problem: Acid mein 1 mol KMnO₄ kitne mol Fe²⁺ oxidise karta hai?
examples.solution: MnO₄⁻ 5 electrons leta hai (+7 → +2); har Fe²⁺ 1 deta hai → 5 mol Fe²⁺.

examples.title: Dichromate ke electrons
examples.problem: Ek Cr₂O₇²⁻ ko Cr³⁺ tak reduce karne mein electrons?

examples.title: Colourless ions
examples.problem: Sc³⁺, Ti³⁺, Cu²⁺, Mn²⁺ mein colourless kaun?
examples.solution: Sc³⁺ — ye 3d⁰ hai, isliye koi d–d transition possible nahi.

examples.title: Copper aur acids
examples.problem: Copper dilute HCl se hydrogen kyun nahi nikaalta?
examples.solution: E°(Cu²⁺/Cu) = +0.34 V positive hai, isliye Cu H⁺ ko H₂ mein reduce nahi kar sakta. Copper sirf HNO₃ jaise oxidising acids mein ghulta hai.

topics.title: Position and classification
topics.explain: d-block: groups 3–12, periods 4–7 (3d, 4d, 5d, 6d series). f-block: lanthanoids (Ce–Lu, 4f) aur actinoids (Th–Lr, 5f), table ke neeche alag.

topics.title: Physical properties
topics.explain: Hard, high melting aur boiling points, achhe conductors. Melting point series ke beech mein sabse zyada (zyada unpaired d electrons, strong bonding); Mn aur Zn anomalously kam. Series mein atomic radii kam badalte hain.

topics.title: Ionisation enthalpies and oxidation states
topics.explain: Series mein IE dheere badhta hai. Oxidation states ki sankhya Mn tak badhti hai (+2 se +7) phir ghatti hai. Higher states O aur F se stable hoti hain (MnO₄⁻, CrO₃, VF₅).

topics.title: Catalytic properties
topics.explain: Variable oxidation states aur reactants ko adsorb karne ki kshamta transition metals ko achha catalyst banati hai: V₂O₅ (contact process), Fe (Haber process), Ni (hydrogenation), MnO₂ (KClO₃ ka decomposition).

topics.title: Interstitial compounds and alloys
topics.explain: Chhote atoms (H, C, N) metal lattice mein fit hokar use hard aur high-melting banate hain (steel, TiC). Milte-julte atomic size se transition metals alloy banate hain jaise brass (Cu–Zn) aur bronze (Cu–Sn).

topics.title: Lanthanoids
topics.explain: Mainly +3, rangeen ions (La³⁺, Lu³⁺ ko chhod kar), reactive metals, aur series mein hydroxides kam basic hote jaate hain. Mischmetal (lanthanoid alloy) lighter flints mein use hota hai.

topics.title: Actinoids and comparison
topics.explain: Saare actinoids radioactive hain. Inme zyada oxidation states (+7 tak) kyunki 5f, 6d aur 7s ki energies paas hain. Actinoid contraction lanthanoid contraction se zyada hai kyunki 5f electrons aur bhi kharab shield karte hain.

ratta: Mn shows max +7;  Sc only +3;  Zn only +2.
CrO₄²⁻ yellow ⇌ Cr₂O₇²⁻ orange (pH, not redox).
